title: Position Analysis in League of Legends
description: League of Legends is a highly competitive, role based game of teamwork. This project analyzes a dataset on the majority of League of Legends competitive matches in 2025 and explores predicting a player's distinct role on the team - based on their post game performance. This project involves the many stages of conducting a data analysis project. https://zchryl.github.io/Position-Analysis-in-League/
